_about: THE PLAYGROUND EDITOR'S PROGRESSION (Palle, 2026-11-06: "at the point floor we can only add points. Then one triangle floor we can add triangles and quad ..."). Since the jumbotron went (Palle, same night: "point, wedge, triangle quad all have unique positions in the grid so we could just have if we point at the position and fire when the element is created ... Remove the jumbotron and refer the other prefab to the hand menu") this table says only which construction kinds (model.gd) the glass box offers on a station whose `space_floor` is at or past a row's `from_floor` (commons/artifacts/scaffold_workstation/display.gd, space mode). A TRIANGLE brings its own diagonal. A row marked `hand` is made from the hand menu, not in the box; the box still shows and takes away what was built with it. Things (health, danger, a crate, a plank) are the hand menu's, with its own gates (commons/data/inventory/items.json). Edit by hand.
